emptyList: Nothing written yet. Create something, or tell Yorik in the chat: “Write to the property management that the heating is cold” or “Invoice to Mustermann: 3 hours of consulting at 80 euros”.
changeLook: Change the look: Settings › Letters & invoices
pickOne: Pick a document on the left or create a new letter.
copyCreated: Copy created as a new draft.
finalSince: Finished on {{date}} · won't be changed any more
draftSavedNumber: Draft · saved · will get the number {{number}}
leaveNote: Finalise first: that's when the number is given
missingBefore_invoice: Still missing before the invoice can be finalised
missingBefore_quote: Still missing before the quote can be finalised
subject: Subject
introPlaceholder_quote: Introduction, e.g. “We are pleased to offer you:”
introPlaceholder_invoice: Introduction, e.g. “Thank you for your order. We charge:”
smallBusiness: Small business (Kleinunternehmer, § 19 UStG): no VAT. You can change this in your letterhead.
closingPlaceholder: Closing text (optional). The payment sentence with the due date comes from your letterhead.
eInvoiceWill: Finalising turns this into an e-invoice (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X): the PDF carries the invoice data in machine-readable form and is checked first.
eInvoiceUnavailable: An e-invoice isn't possible here yet: the “ZUGFeRD” extension isn't installed (Settings › Letters & invoices › E-invoices: install ZUGFeRD). Without it you get a plain PDF; you'll be asked when finalising.
finaliseBody_invoice: The invoice gets the number {{number}} and today's date, is kept as a PDF and won't be changed afterwards.
finaliseBody_quote: The quote gets the number {{number}} and today's date, is kept as a PDF and won't be changed afterwards.
finaliseEInvoice: It will be created as a checked e-invoice.
finaliseOnlyIfOk: A number is only given if everything worked.
canContinuePlain: You can finalise it as a plain PDF. For business customers in Germany the e-invoice becomes mandatory from 2027/2028; private customers don't need it.
toInvoiceDone: Invoice created as a draft, with the items from the quote.
nothingToRewrite: There's no text to revise yet.
rewritten: Revised. Undo (↶) brings the old text back.
addClosing: Add the closing and name from your letterhead (turn off if the text already signs off)
rewritePlaceholder: Yorik, revise it: friendlier, shorter, firmer … (selected text or the whole letter)
letterSent: Sent. The letter is now finished and is under “Sent and filed”.
letterFiled: Filed in Paperless. The letter is now finished.
finalNote: After this the letter is finished and won't be changed; “As new draft” makes a copy if needed.
noAccount: You haven't set up an email account in Yorik yet (app “Email” → Add account). Until then: open the PDF and send it yourself.
sendAsTextNote: The letter goes straight into the email: your text, the closing and your name — without letterhead and address block. It is still kept as a PDF under “Finished”.
messageLabel: Message (the letter is attached as a PDF)
fileBody: The letter goes into your documents as a PDF. Who may see it there?
addressPlaceholder:
Street and number
Postcode and town
noAddress: This contact has no address on file. You can enter it here.
previewNote: This is how the first page will be printed. The look comes from your letterhead.
sendDefaultBody:
Hello,

please find my letter attached as a PDF.

Kind regards
